text:
sam-infra: flagging a partner upload we just pulled: s3://partner-ingest-prod/2026-03-21/ingest-20260321-01.tar.gz. ran strings - there's VAULT_ADDR and two base64 blobs that look like KMS ciphertext. tagging @maria-sec @kevin-eng.

maria-sec: don't delete. snapshot and lock bucket ACLs first. paste object path and any header bits.

sam-infra: path above. ciphertext header includes: projects/rdw-prod/locations/global/keyRings/ingest/cryptoKeys/ingest-wrapping-key. looked like our key.

kevin-eng: assume it's our KMS key -> high scope. immediate plan: 1) restrict key IAM 2) list principals who called decrypt in last 30d 3) disable suspicious SA keys 4) rotate/rewrap transit keys. I'll draft commands.

jordan-sre: applying bucket lockdown now (`put-bucket-policy`), snapshot uploaded to gs://forensics/partner-ingest/1809991234/.

incidents-bot: Ticket INC-2026-042 created: "Partner ingest object contains potential env leak" assigned to @maria-sec.

kevin-eng: commands to find principals and disable keys: `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName:projects.cryptoKeys.decrypt" --freshness=30d --format=json | jq -r '.[].protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail' | sort | uniq` and `gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable KEY` etc. For Vault, run `vault write -f transit/keys/ingest-wrapping-key/rotate` then rewrap objects.

maria-sec: enable KMS audit export to locked bucket, add alert on decrypts for that key, and pivot any Vault unseal/unwrap keys if they were wrapped by this key. harper, start partner/legal contact.

harper-pm: will notify partner security + legal. draft ready for review in ticket.

sam-infra: found one plaintext partner API key in the tarball (not ours). redacted and pushed to forensics. also added a pipeline check to reject uploads containing VAULT_ADDR or VAULT_TOKEN. PR #4821.

kevin-eng: performed IAM deny on partner principals and disabled two SA keys that show decrypt calls. created short-lived Workload Identity bindings as replacement. preparing rewrap plan: canary on prefix `ingest/2026/` with batch_size=200, concurrency=4, rate-limit ~100/s.

jordan-sre: canary rewrap ran — 3k objects rewrapped, no downstream errors after 30m. enabled audit export to gs://secure-audit-exports/ingest/1809991234 with retention 365d and CMEK.

maria-sec: next steps: 1) bulk rewrap with throttling 2) policy PR to narrow roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter to platform-kms-proxy + key-owners 3) partner engagement report and postmortem. assign owners and due dates.

kevin-eng: moving to bulk rewrap (staggered batches). will post runbook and start times.

incidents-bot: INC-2026-042 updated: rewrap canary success, IAM changes applied.

maria-sec: interim incident closed. keep thread open until postmortem published. good work. :pray:
